title: Lie Algebraic Uncertainty Relations
summary: Uncertainty relations impose fundamental constraints on quantum observables, yet optimal bounds are needed to determine their incompatibility through the minimum attainable uncertainty. Here we introduce a covariance-matrix formulation from which infinitely many uncertainty relations follow, encompassing Hermitian observables and non-Hermitian operators and recovering the variance sum as a special case.
